subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

P_T P_S_C T_R S P C_P R_P_T_R S
solution:
Given : P_T P_S_C T_R S P C_P R_P_T_R S

By checking options :

 
• CRPCSPPT → P__**C**__TP__**R**__S/ __**P**__C T__**C**__RS /P C__**S**__P R__**P/ **__P__**P**__T__**T**__R S → **(**It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• CSPCRPTP → P__C__TP__S__S/ __P__C T__C__RS /P C__R__P R__P/ __P__T__T__P__R S → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• CRPPTSCP → P__C__TP__R__S/ __P__C T__P__RS /P C__T__PR__S/ __P__C__T__P__R S → ((It follows the pattern of : PCTPRS - PCTPRS - PCTPRS - PCTPRS)
 
• CCPPPRST → P__C__TP__C__S/ __P__CT__P__RS /P C__P__P R__R/ __P__S__T__T__R S → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

Hence, "CRPPTSCP" is the correct answer.
